title: The Reconfiguration Premium: Co-movement Structure as an Unspanned Dimension of the Variance Risk Premium
abstract: arXiv:2608.20020v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hedge ratios, factor models and diversified portfolios all rest on an estimate of which firms move together. That estimate is not stable: firms migrate between the groupings the market treats as coherent, and when enough migrate the organizing axes of the cross-section turn. We measure the rate of that turning as the mean squared sine of the principal angles between subdominant eigenspaces of consecutive twelve-month S&P 500 correlation matrices. A typical month rewrites a fifth of the structure and carries four-fifths forward. That rate is priced: it couples to the aggregate variance risk premium at t = 5.40, no level measure correlates above 0.32, and the implied-correlation surface spans at most 6.7 percent of it. Only the persistent component is priced - the premium compensates the pace of revision, not the distance traveled. The mechanism is prepayment: implied variance rises on impact, volatility follows two to three quarters later

translated_title: 重构溢价：共同运动结构作为方差风险溢价的非跨越维度
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.20020v1 公告类型：新 摘要：对冲比率、因子模型和分散化投资组合都依赖于对公司共同运动方式的估计。这种估计并不稳定：公司会在市场视为一致的分组之间迁移，当足够多的公司迁移时，横截面的组织轴就会转变。我们通过连续十二个月S&P 500相关矩阵的次主导特征空间之间主角的均方正弦来度量这种转变速率。一个典型的月份会重写五分之一的结构，并保留五分之四。该速率是有定价的：它与总体方差风险溢价在t=5.40时耦合，没有水平度量相关系数超过0.32，隐含相关曲面最多解释其6.7%。只有持续性成分被定价——溢价补偿的是修正的节奏，而非距离。机制是预付效应：隐含方差在冲击时上升，波动性在两到三个季度后跟进。
tldr: 本文发现股票共同运动结构的重构速率是方差风险溢价的非跨越定价维度，其机制为预付效应，且只有持续性成分被定价。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the reconfiguration rate of stock co-movement structure is an unspanned pricing dimension of the variance risk premium, driven by a prepayment mechanism where only the persistent component is priced.
